Games Action Games Grand Theft Auto GTA 6 GTA 6 leaker threatens to release a build of the entire game start to finish, but gives Take-Two a way out: "Physical disks and a public apology" News By Kaan Serin Published 11 October 2026 Cyberleek makes new demands When you purchase through links on our site, we may earn an affiliate commission. Here's how it works . (Image credit: Rockstar Games) Copy link Facebook X Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 0 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter The notorious GTA 6 leaker known only by their online moniker Cyberleek is back with a new threat. Should their memecoin's market cap hit $30 million, Cyberleek says they'll release a start-to-finish playable build of Rockstar Games ' long-awaited open worlder. Cyberleek's threat, posted to their website and reposted elsewhere online, also gives parent company Take-Two an ultimatum of sorts. The leaker says Take-Two can make this whole fiasco go away by printing physical GTA 6 discs and issuing a public apology. "Here's the deal, nice and clean. CYBERLEEK hits 30 million marketcap, the build goes out - full story mode, played to the end, credits and all," the leaker writes on their website. "Don't believe it has full story mode? Ask for what you want to see, and it gets provided. Take-Two gets one way out: physical disks and a public apology. They can take it at any moment. Or they can gamble that CL is bluffing. Everyone knows which one they'll pick." Latest Videos From GamesRadar+ Watch full video here: This isn't the first time Cyberleek's made demands around physical games. An older manifesto railed against practices such as digital pre-orders, "fake" single-player DLC and code-in-a-box physical editions - though game preservation group Stop Killing Games disagreed with the leaker's methods : "Using illegal means to make a point is unacceptable to us and does nothing to protect our right to keep using what we paid for." The latest drama comes days after Cyberleek released roughly 24-minutes of new GTA 6 footage showing everything from a first-person mode to a nude Jason and in-game racing events. An even more recent leak supposedly features gameplay from a topless Lucia's perspective. You may like GTA 6 leaker turns to story spoilers: Cyberleek uploads 4-minute Lucia prologue clip Latest GTA 6 leaks see Cyberleek threaten Rockstar with Lucia story spoilers - and examine nude NPCs GTA 6 leaker Cyberleek returns with 25 minutes of new gameplay footage after over a month of silence GTA 6's history with leakage goes back years, though the Cyberleek saga only kicked off in earnest earlier this summer when the hacker - or hacking group - shed light on the game's map well before its Netflix blowout. Many thought the drama would've ended when Cyberleek squeezed $250,000 out of their crypto scheme before going radio silent for weeks. Rockstar previously addressed the leaks and called them "heartbreaking for our team," while warning that any leaked footage might contain spoilers.
